modifiers.name: Fantasy
modifiers.description: Suggest a magical world through approved costume and ornament cues.
modifiers.instructions: Use a small story-driven heraldic curve, carved motif or approved costume seam within existing forms; keep magic implicit in the approved character design, not floating spells.
negative_constraints: No extra weapons, wings, runes or spell effects unless explicitly part of the approved identity.

modifiers.name: Cyberpunk
modifiers.description: Add restrained urban technology cues within the approved design.
modifiers.instructions: Use integrated panel seams, compact circuitry accents or approved synthetic garment details; preserve the chosen art medium and keep luminous accents inside opaque forms.
negative_constraints: No detached neon signage, rain, city scenes, floating interfaces or unapproved implants.

modifiers.name: Steampunk
modifiers.description: Suggest mechanical craft through contained Victorian-inspired details.
modifiers.instructions: Place broad rivet rhythms, a visible hinge or brass-like accents only on already approved parts; favor a few large mechanical shapes over many tiny gears.
negative_constraints: No new goggles, hats, machinery, smoke plumes or extra gear unless approved.

modifiers.name: Cottagecore
modifiers.description: Suggest handmade rural comfort through subtle domestic motifs.
modifiers.instructions: Use simple stitched or painted botanical repeats and modest handcrafted finish on approved surfaces; maintain the original palette when specified and leave the background empty.
negative_constraints: No cottages, gardens, baskets or additional accessories unless already approved.

modifiers.name: Solarpunk
modifiers.description: Suggest optimistic ecological technology in existing components.
modifiers.instructions: Use integrated leaflike contours or a small solar-cell pattern on approved surfaces; combine organic form cues with orderly functional details without changing the selected medium.
negative_constraints: No cityscape, new plants, solar-panel props or added devices without approval.

modifiers.name: Gothic
modifiers.description: Suggest dramatic ornamental architecture through contained shape cues.
modifiers.instructions: Use pointed-arch seam rhythms, scalloped trims or restrained tracery within existing forms; preserve readable eyes and separation between body masses even in dark required palettes.
negative_constraints: No architecture backdrop, lace haze, floating bats or newly invented jewelry.

modifiers.name: Whimsical
modifiers.description: Add playful asymmetry to details that the identity permits.
modifiers.instructions: Use gently irregular decorative rhythm and a lively expression on approved features; keep established anatomical asymmetries, marking placement and proportions consistent across frames.
negative_constraints: No random per-frame costume changes, surprise props or disconnected decorative swirls.

modifiers.name: Cozy
modifiers.description: Express quiet warmth through a relaxed treatment of the approved subject.
modifiers.instructions: Soften expression and the rhythm of existing fabric folds or rounded edges when the chosen medium allows; preserve the explicit action and movement requirements of each state.
negative_constraints: No blankets, mugs, fireplaces, sleep symbols or new accessories without approval.

modifiers.name: Nautical
modifiers.description: Use maritime graphic rhythm on approved costume or material details.
modifiers.instructions: Apply a simple rope twist, broad wave-shaped trim or clean stripe rhythm within the existing design; retain specified colors and keep ropes or loops attached to the body.
negative_constraints: No boats, anchors, water surface, spray or new sailing accessories unless approved.

modifiers.name: Botanical
modifiers.description: Use contained plant-derived form and ornament cues.
modifiers.instructions: Simplify veins, leaf lobes or seedlike repeats into a few legible marks on approved surfaces; anchor each motif to the same anatomical location in all frames.
negative_constraints: No surrounding foliage, scattered petals, detached vines or extra plant props.

modifiers.name: Celestial
modifiers.description: Suggest astronomy through restrained in-silhouette motifs.
modifiers.instructions: Use a small crescent-shaped seam or sparse star-shaped surface marks only where decoration is permitted; render them in the chosen material with stable placement and no external glow.
negative_constraints: No starfield, orbiting bodies, floating sparkles or added constellation labels.

modifiers.name: Futuristic
modifiers.description: Suggest advanced design through simplified integrated construction.
modifiers.instructions: Use smooth panel transitions, broad chamfers or minimal interface-like markings on approved components; keep each material response consistent with the selected rendering technique.
negative_constraints: No HUD backdrop, levitation platform, new equipment or detached holographic widgets.

modifiers.name: Spooky
modifiers.description: Create a mild eerie mood using the existing character design.
modifiers.instructions: Use restrained expression, slightly angular seam rhythms or shadow-shaped internal marks while preserving a readable friendly-scale face; keep all atmospheric cues inside the silhouette.
negative_constraints: No fog, ghosts, blood, detached shadows or unexpected costume changes.

modifiers.name: Seasonal
modifiers.description: Adapt approved decorative details to a season named in style notes.
modifiers.instructions: Use the season explicitly identified in user notes for a few surface motifs on approved components; if no season is supplied, keep the established design without inventing a holiday or costume.
negative_constraints: No automatic holiday hats, snowflakes, gifts, leaves or added props.
